title: NASA's Earth Fact Sheet lists an escape velocity of 11.186 km/s
summary: The fact sheet lists Earth's escape velocity as 11.186 kilometers per second.
body: NASA's Earth Fact Sheet lists an escape velocity of 11.186 kilometers per second. Mean surface gravity on the same sheet is already on the shape card. Escape velocity is a different line.
